CustomField.description: Donor tier worked out from Total Gifts Paid, the roll-up of Donor Gift Summary Total Gifts Amount.
CustomField.formula: IF( Total_Gifts_Paid__c >= 5000, "Leadership", IF( Total_Gifts_Paid__c >= 2500, "Major", IF( Total_Gifts_Paid__c >= 1000, "Mid", IF( Total_Gifts_Paid__c >= 250, "Engaged", IF( Total_Gifts_Paid__c < 25, "(none)", "" ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Donor Tiers
